description: This file defines functions to load patterns and create a Vitest configuration specific to an IRC extension, and exports a default configuration.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns from environment variables or defaults to specific test file patterns.

methods.name: export function createExtensionIrcVitestConfig( createExtensionIrcVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns a Vitest configuration object tailored for the IRC extension, optionally merging environment variable patterns.
